title: RunState
description: Durable state of an AgentRun workflow (RUN-001/RUN-004). This is the shape checkpointed by Temporal at each superstep; it must remain serializable and must never contain a chain-of-thought field.

agent_manifest_ref.description: name@version of the AgentManifest driving this run.

graph_cursor.description: Position in the graph runtime (RUN-002): which node(s) are active/pending per branch.

tool_call_hash.description: Hash of bound parameters; an approval only applies if this matches at execution time.

no_progress_counter.description: Consecutive supersteps without new evidence/state change; hard-stops runaway loops.
